+

+            p['move_ee']([x, y, grasp_z], quat, speed=0.09, settle=3)

+            p['move_ee']([x, y, 0.36], quat, speed=0.18, settle=3)

+            p['move_ee']([0.335, 0.385, 0.39], quat, speed=0.22, settle=2)
